lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har chetahu a(n)t hoi sakhaaee ||
lines.translation: Think of the Lord, who shall be your Help and Support in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har agam agochar anaath ajonee satigur kai bhaai paavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. He has no master, and He is not born. He is obtained through love of the True Guru. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree aap nivaaraniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who eliminate selfishness and conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap gavaae taa har paae har siu sahaj samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: They eradicate selfishness and conceit, and then find the Lord; they are intuitively immersed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhiaa s karam kamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: According to their pre-ordained destiny, they act out their karma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, a lasting peace is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin bhaagaa gur paaeeai naahee sabadai mel milaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: Without good fortune, the Guru is not found. Through the Word of the Shabad, they are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh alipat rahai sa(n)saare ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs remain unaffected in the midst of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਤਕੀਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai takeeai naam adhaare ||
lines.translation: The Guru is their cushion, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is their Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਖਪਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jor kare kiaa tis no aape khap dukh paavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Who can oppress the Gurmukh? One who tries shall perish, writhing in pain. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe sudh na kaaee ||
lines.translation: The blind self-willed manmukhs have no understanding at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ਹੈ ਜਗਤ ਕਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aatam ghaatee hai jagat kasaaee ||
lines.translation: They are the assassins of the self, and the butchers of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਭਾਰੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)daa kar kar bahu bhaar uthaavai bin majooree bhaar pahuchaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: By continually slandering others, they carry a terrible load, and they carry the loads of others for nothing. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਾੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu jag vaaRee meraa prabh maalee ||
lines.translation: This world is a garden, and my Lord God is the Gardener.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa samaale ko naahee khaalee ||
lines.translation: He always takes care of it-nothing is exempt from His Care.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਪਾਏ ਤੇਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਾਸੂ ਵਾਸੁ ਜਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jehee vaasanaa paae tehee varatai vaasoo vaas janaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: As is the fragrance which He bestows, so is the fragrant flower known. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh rogee hai sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are sick and diseased in the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhadaataa visariaa agam apaaraa ||
lines.translation: They have forgotten the Giver of peace, the Unfathomable, the Infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਨਿਤਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: dukheee nit phirahi bilalaade bin gur saa(n)t na paavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: These miserable people wander endlessly, crying out in pain; without the Guru, they find no peace. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin keete soee bidh jaanai ||
lines.translation: The One who created them, knows their condition.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap kare taa hukam pachhaanai ||
lines.translation: And if He inspires them, then they realize the Hukam of His Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jehaa a(n)dar paae tehaa varatai aape baahar paavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: Whatever He places within them, that is what prevails, and so they outwardly appear. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis baajhahu sache mai hor na koee ||
lines.translation: I know of no other except the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis laai lae so niramal hoee ||
lines.translation: Those, whom the Lord attaches to Himself, become pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੪॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghat a(n)tar jis devai so paavaniaa ||8||14||15||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the heart of those, unto whom He has given it. ||8||14||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
lines.translation: Enshrining the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the mind,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai meraa sabh dukh gavaae ||
lines.translation: all the pains of egotism, selfishness and conceit are eliminated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee sadaa salaahe a(n)mrit a(n)mrit paavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: By continually praising the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, I obtain the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree a(n)mrit baanee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Bani of the Word within their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee ma(n)n vasaae a(n)mrit naam dhiaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Enshrining the Ambrosial Bani in their minds, they meditate on the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਵੈਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit bolai sadaa mukh vainee ||
lines.translation: Those who continually chant the Ambrosial Words of Nectar,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਰਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit vekhai parakhai sadaa nainee ||
lines.translation: See and behold this Amrit everywhere with their eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਕਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਰਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਨਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit kathaa kahai sadaa din raatee avaraa aakh sunaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: They continually chant the Ambrosial Sermon day and night; chanting it, they cause others to hear it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit ra(n)g rataa liv laae ||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Ambrosial Love of the Lord, they lovingly focus their attention on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit gur parasaadee paae ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, they receive this Amrit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit rasanaa bolai din raatee man tan a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: They chant the Ambrosial Name with their tongues day and night; their minds and bodies are satisfied by this Amrit. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so kichh karai j chit na hoee ||
lines.translation: That which God does is beyond anyone's consciousness;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis daa hukam met na sakai koee ||
lines.translation: no one can erase the Hukam of His Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: hukame varatai a(n)mrit baanee hukame a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: By His Command, the Ambrosial Bani of the Word prevails, and by His Command, we drink in the Amrit. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਬ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ajab ka(n)m karate har kere ||
lines.translation: The actions of the Creator Lord are marvellous and wonderful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਫੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man bhoolaa jaa(n)daa phere ||
lines.translation: This mind is deluded, and goes around the wheel of reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee siu chit laae a(n)mrit sabad vajaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: Those who focus their consciousness on the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, hear the vibrations of the Ambrosial Word of the Shabad. ||5||
